_doc: Trigger cases for run_trigger_eval.py. expect = any-of list of skill/workflow names the FIRST Skill call must hit; [] = no skill must be invoked. forbid = names that must not be invoked. Add a case whenever a skill is added or its description changes; keep prompts realistic (how the user actually asks, VI or EN).
